# Stock OS files and which projects need which

Most mods start from a stock OS file that the user downloads from Elektron, and accept exactly one version, recognised by its SHA-256. This page shows which version each project needs, how fast projects moved when Elektron released a new OS, and the hash of every stock file the projects publish. Source: [`data/stock-os.yml`](../data/stock-os.yml); "pinned by" counts the catalogued repositories that hold the exact value (searched 2026-11-18; vendored copies count).

Always compare the hash against the file you actually downloaded. A matching hash only says you hold the file a project expects; it says nothing about whether the mod is safe. `[doc]`

## Which OS the projects need (the releases of 2026-10-01)

Elektron released Digitakt II 1.17, Digitone II 1.12 and Syntakt 1.42 on the same day. Use: *patch* builds firmware from it; *donor* takes parts of it for another device; *analysis* emulator or research; *runs-on* the unit must run it.

### Digitakt II: newest OS 1.17 (since 2026-10-01)

18 projects accept 1.17 (4 moved from an older OS, 12 started on it); 4 need an older file. A unit runs one OS, so mods that need different versions cannot be combined on it.

## How fast projects moved

Only projects that existed before the release and moved to it. The date is the first commit that supports the new version.

| Device | OS | Project | Days | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Digitakt II | 1.17 | [elekloader](../p/elekloader/) | 3 | commit 827bc68 "The Digitakt II (OS 1.17): sealed builds, core-dt2 and an example mod" |

| Digitakt II | 1.17 | [digikit](../p/digikit/) | 12 | commit f75da50b "Onboard DT2 1.17 and DN2 1.12" |

| Digitone II | 1.12 | [Modwerk (formerly Octamod)](../p/modwerk/) | 22 | commit a829d349 "Digitone II OS 1.12 research and a draft core in the emulator (#808)" |
| Digitone II | 1.12 | [elekloader](../p/elekloader/) | 23 | commit b9006bf "Add experimental Digitone II OS 1.12 support (#166)" |
| Syntakt | 1.42 | [Synfact](../p/synfact/) | 47 | commit 276667a "move to OS 1.42" |
